byte_ceiling_basis: One whole public exchange metadata response; 5 MiB hard bound, no retry, alias, pagination or fallback on saturation.
question: Does the public COIN-M schema establish a currently tradable, BTC-margin, USD-quote current-quarter inverse candidate distinct from the old USDT-linear carry scope? No economic data request under this contract.
selection: Only BTC baseAsset, marginAsset BTC, quoteAsset USD, pair BTCUSD, CURRENT_QUARTER and status TRADING, expiry strictly after freeze, positive finite contractSize, unique candidate. Do not select an alternative asset/quarter after access.
adjudication_rule: One zero-network metadata classification. Record candidate absence, unavailable schema, fee/FX/margin unknowns or a unique qualifying metadata row. Metadata alone does not prove inverse settlement/PnL law or margin rules. Never infer USD=USDT parity, native commission, liquidation immunity, profitability, price permission or live product authority.
prior_scope_distinction: Existing screen_binance_quarterly_carry filters fapi USDT margin; this asks only about dapi BTC margin/contract-face units. It does not retry its quotes or account contract, or introduce order-capable COIN-M support.
